How the advisor works: screenshots + text recognition -> game tracker -> the rl-v3 network (win chance + a probability per choice).

Strengths: ~1 ms per network question; advice for every base-set prompt; deck count matched the autopilot's at every turn of two recorded games (one buy a turn late; received Curses only the advisor counts).
Fixed: a misread Copper pile once gave 116 cards on turn 2; OCR reads went from 9 s to 0.3 s; CPU ~11% of a core idle, ~2/3 while playing.
Weaknesses: opponent's plays unseen, draw order guessed, fast trashes can be missed, mid-game start credits you with the opponent's early buys.
Next: decode game memory, match card art instead of names, log the opponent's plays, check that the win chance is calibrated.
